name: Local Wake-Word Gated Streaming
summary: Monitors local microphone audio continuously using sounddevice and numpy, preventing audio streaming to Google Gemini Live API until the wake phrase 'Hey Jarvis' is detected.
steps: Sample local audio buffer using sounddevice and numpy.
Pass audio frame buffers into local wake-word detection engine.
Establish cloud audio socket stream to Gemini Live API only after 'Hey Jarvis' is verified.
jarvis_use: Protect user privacy and save API costs by keeping the microphone stream local until explicitly triggered.

name: Inactivity Auto-Sleep Mode
summary: Automatically terminates active cloud API audio sessions after 2 minutes of audio silence and returns to local wake-word monitoring.
steps: Start inactivity timer upon completion of user command or assistant response.
Monitor local audio signal level for silence.
If 120 seconds elapse without audio input, close cloud connection and return to standby mode.
jarvis_use: Automatically reduce background token consumption and memory usage when Jarvis is left idle.

name: Instant Non-Blocking Voice Acknowledgment
summary: Plays localized voice confirmation immediately on the local system while initiating background tool calls asynchronously to eliminate perceived response dead air.
steps: Capture user intent from speech input stream.
Trigger immediate localized audio response ('On it, sir') on primary audio output thread.
Dispatch application launch or automation tool on a non-blocking background thread.
Log event to HUD execution terminal upon completion.
jarvis_use: Provide instant acoustic feedback to macOS users so desktop commands feel zero-latency.

name: Self-Describing Plugin Auto-Registration
summary: Scans the dedicated `plugins/` folder during startup and dynamically registers self-describing tool modules into the agent's function registry without modifying `main.py`.
steps: Create standalone plugin script containing metadata definition and execution entry point in `plugins/`.
Execute directory import scanner on application launch.
Inspect each module contract and dynamically register tools to the model function schema.
jarvis_use: Allow users to add new custom capabilities to Jarvis by dropping Python files into a plugins directory.

name: Silent Subprocess Execution Flag
summary: Checks operating system type and applies `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` flags to subprocess creation on Windows to prevent pop-up command prompt windows during background tasks.
steps: Detect runtime platform using `platform.system()`.
If system is Windows, pass `creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW` parameter.
Invoke background system shell execution via `subprocess.Popen` or `subprocess.run`.
jarvis_use: Run background scripts and automation utilities silently without disrupting desktop visual workflow.

name: PyQt5 Circular Visualizer HUD Window
summary: Renders a dark-mode desktop interface featuring a central reactive circular visualizer, real-time activity log console, and status indicators.
steps: Import PyQt5 core, widget, and GUI modules.
Construct dark-themed main window with custom circular visualizer canvas.
Attach side terminal panel for streaming real-time status and command logs (`[open_app] Microsoft Edge`).
Add interactive status indicators and action buttons.
jarvis_use: Build a responsive visual HUD for Jarvis on desktop to show state, audio visualization, and live activity logs.

name: GUI Emergency Process Kill Switch
summary: Provides a dedicated red emergency stop button in the desktop interface that halts background thread execution and kills running subprocesses.
steps: Add red `EMERGENCY STOP` QPushButton to visual HUD layout.
Bind click signal to global process termination handler.
Terminate active background automation threads and subprocess instances instantly upon button click.
jarvis_use: Provide a quick visual safety kill-switch to immediately abort runaway automation tasks on macOS.

name: Console Stdout Re-encoding Guard
summary: Reconfigures system standard output and error streams to UTF-8 with fallback try/except handling to prevent unicode console encoding crashes.
steps: Execute `sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')` on script initialization.
Wrap reconfigure call inside try/except block to handle incompatible terminal environments safely.
Stream unicode log output without raising UnicodeEncodeError.
jarvis_use: Prevent terminal crashes when logging unicode characters across diverse host terminal setups.

name: QR Code Remote Mobile Dashboard Architecture
summary: Hosts a local web server and generates a QR code on the desktop display, enabling direct remote assistant management from a mobile phone browser.
steps: Initialize local web server on designated host port.
Generate local IP connection URL and render QR code string in desktop UI.
Scan QR code using mobile device to open interactive remote dashboard control panel.
jarvis_use: Allow users to monitor and trigger Jarvis capabilities from their mobile phone over local Wi-Fi.
